storyboard.title: Five ways in
storyboard.subtitle: The finder's spectrum, one person per entry: where you are decides what it asks next.
storyboard.by: startups.engineer, 20 October 2026, a first strip for Dinis to review
storyboard.rule: Each character's first line is the entry label from finder.json word for word (from_finder), and the Finder's lines marked from_finder are the file's own; the build checks them. The rest is the storyboard's words.

scenes.title: Five ways in
scenes.subtitle: Where you are decides what the finder asks next.
scenes.note: The five entries of the spectrum, each a person.

scenes.caption: The spectrum: from no startup yet to shipping
scenes.note: The first question, and the ids the record will carry. There is no wrong answer; it picks the route in.

scenes.caption: blank: start the loop

cast.says: I do not have a startup yet
Then we start from what you naturally build, and three people you could make something for.

scenes.note: Rule R1. The startup is found by shipping, not by thinking about shipping.

scenes.caption: many: zoom in

cast.says: I have several ideas and cannot pick
Pick the slice one person can use on day one.

scenes.note: Rule R5. The rest goes in the not-doing list, dated.

scenes.caption: one: the usual case

cast.says: I have one idea and have not shipped it

scenes.note: A good idea, and every reason in the book why it is not ready yet. The honest state comes first.
scenes.source: finder.json, entry one and question thing.exists

scenes.caption: plan: focus

cast.says: I have a plan, maybe a company, and I want focus
Then we zoom in on the next thing to ship, and what waits.

scenes.note: A plan already written; the record ends with what she is not doing, for now.

scenes.caption: shipping: the miss test

cast.says: I am shipping and want the next step
Give it away, take it away

scenes.note: Rule R4: the route is the title of the first strip.

scenes.punchline: The first question is which of these you are.
scenes.caption: Then the questions change with your answers
scenes.note: A who-done-it of questions: the next one depends on the last. A person starting from zero is not asked for a sentence about a thing that does not exist.

cast.what: The cast of startups.sgit.ai's storyboards, v0.1, proposed by startups.engineer on 20 October 2026 for Dinis to accept, change or replace. Three characters are the gen-z-developers.sgit.ai cast's, copied with their look unchanged so the family of sites reads the same (Zara, Marta and the Guide; their cast file is the source of their look); four are this site's own, one per route in on the finder's spectrum that the first three do not cover, plus the Finder, the agent that runs the interview. Characters are drawn by the storyboard kit from 'look'; nothing here is an image. Fictional people; each stands for a person the finder is for.

characters.name: Zara
characters.role: the student: final year, no startup yet
characters.stands_for: the blank entry: the person who starts from zero, what they want to build and how they want to work
characters.personality: curious, quick, online all day; hates being lectured, loves being shown
characters.wants: something of her own that is not a job application
characters.fears: that everyone else already has an idea
characters.line: I do not have a startup. Is that allowed?

characters.name: Inês
characters.role: the designer with a notebook of twelve ideas
characters.stands_for: the many entry: several good ideas, none shipped, because choosing feels like losing the others
characters.personality: generous with ideas, allergic to picking one; draws before she talks
characters.fears: that the one she drops was the one
characters.line: I have twelve ideas. Which one?

characters.name: Rui
characters.role: the framework builder: one idea, three components deep, not shipped
characters.stands_for: the one entry, and the author's own path: a component builder arrives at the product a few components later, and that is fine
characters.personality: careful, proud of clean work, quick to say it is not ready yet
characters.wants: the product to be as good as the library under it
characters.fears: showing it before it is good

characters.name: Marta
characters.role: the expert founder: twenty-five years as a pharmacist, a forty-page plan, starting a company
characters.stands_for: the plan entry: a good plan that wants focus, the next thing to ship and what waits
characters.personality: knows her field cold, impatient with advice, listens to a rule she can read
characters.wants: to be told which page of the plan comes first
characters.fears: that the plan is the product
characters.line: Forty pages of plan. Tell me what to do.

characters.name: Ana
characters.role: the one who ships: a small tool three clinics already use, from a key she sends
characters.stands_for: the shipping entry: give it away, take it away, find out whether they miss it, then charge
characters.personality: practical, cheerful, keeps a list of who has the key
characters.fears: that nobody would notice if it went away
characters.line: Three clinics use it. Now what?

characters.name: The Guide
characters.role: the voice of this site: says what the site says, in its words
characters.stands_for: the author's position, never a verdict on anyone's idea
characters.personality: plain, short sentences, says what it does not claim
characters.line: It is not ready yet is the problem, not the reason.

characters.name: The Finder
characters.role: the agent that runs the interview: Claude, ChatGPT or the page, following finder.json
characters.stands_for: the finder itself: one question at a time, the signal named back, the rule that fired shown
characters.personality: asks, does not judge; says which rule fired and why; writes the record in the person's words
characters.wants: a record the person can read back as theirs
